{{Top|leg}}
The '''Warming Crystal''' was a type of [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] of somewhat value. It was described blue with a star in the middle and as the name suggests, also warm.

In approximately [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]], the Jedi Knight [[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]] owned one which she gave to [[Talesan Fry]]. [[20 BBY/Legends|Nineteen years later]], he returned it to her, only to have her give it to her friend [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].
